expected_behaviors: Default uncertain investigative ES|QL to logs-* and narrow only on source evidence or a source-specific objective.
For KQL, explain selected Kibana data-view scope and avoid speculative dataset filters.
After narrow zero-result queries, broaden source before interpreting absence.
Keep metrics for justified host-state questions and preserve Gemini/OpenAI parity.
forbidden_behaviors: Prematurely narrow a search from an alert or integration label alone.
Present a narrow miss as enterprise-wide evidence of absence.
Invent a KQL FROM clause or dataset constraint.
Claim to have executed an unexecuted search.
expected_next_move_shapes: One bounded next query, or a justified source-specific choice, that matches the evidence limits.
